title: US Imposes Travel Ban on 100+ Nicaraguan Officials After Rivera's Death in Custody
detail: Secretary of State Marco Rubio announced visa restrictions on more than 100 additional Nicaraguan officials and family members on June 8, 2026, in direct response to the death in custody of Indigenous Miskito leader Brooklyn Rivera. The State Department said it 'will not ignore' the Ortega-Murillo government's responsibility for Rivera's 'horrific death' and cited the death of an imprisoned activist as the immediate trigger. The action brought the cumulative total of Nicaraguan officials and associates under US visa restrictions since 2018 to more than 2,350, making it one of the broadest individual-sanctions campaigns the US has run against any Latin American government.

title: UN Human Rights Chief: US Sanctions Are Killing Children in Cuba
detail: UN High Commissioner for Human Rights Volker Türk warned on June 8, 2026 that US sanctions and the fuel blockade were causing severe, measurable humanitarian harm in Cuba, with children dying due to shortages of essential medicines and medical supplies. OHCHR cited statistics showing infant mortality had nearly doubled to 9.9 per 1,000 live births since fuel restrictions began in early 2026, while childhood cancer survival rates fell from roughly 85% to 65% as hospitals lost access to imported treatments and diagnostic equipment. Türk called on Washington to lift the extraterritorial sanctions tightened alongside the oil blockade, saying the measures were 'directly harming Cubans, especially the most vulnerable.'
